added: A program shows the types of its dances, such as Contra, English (ECD) or both, at the top of its page and on its row in the programs list.

Chips above the programs list filter it by type: with Only, a chip shows the programs of exactly one mix of types; with Includes, it shows every program that has one type, so Contra also lists programs with both contra and English dances. Searching programs finds them by their types.
ProgramRepository.formsByProgram lists the forms of each program's live dances, and watchFormsByProgram follows them as dances are deleted, restored or changed.
